note: The EXACT SIWE (EIP-4361) message a launcher composes to sign the WEBSITE in (the device-code pairing, meter/signin.py). The nonce is the pairing code. `launcher-rs/crates/elo-broker` composes it and `tests/cross_language.rs` pins the composer; `meter/signin.py` recomposes it to verify a proof and `meter/test_signin.py` pins the recomposer. Neither side moves without this file. issued_at is pinned so the message is a pure function.
